tokenize_text_for_clip: tokenize a string or list of strings into CLIP-compatible token tensors with start and end tokens
create_simple_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance with a custom BPE vocabulary file path and special tokens
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a text string into a list of BPE token IDs using the tokenizer
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of token IDs back into human-readable text using the tokenizer
apply_bpe_tokenization: apply byte pair encoding to a token string and return merged subword tokens
